description: Hand-maintained annotations for the generated HTTP reference. The generator fails when a path-shaped literal in the API definition sources has no entry here, or when an entry matches no literal in the corpus, so this file cannot rot.

routes.description_en: Mint a channel-bound local bearer (management or task) from the bootstrap secret proof.
routes.description_zh: 凭 bootstrap secret 证明铸造通道绑定的本地 bearer（management 或 task）。

routes.description_en: Unauthenticated bounded liveness probe; deliberately not a readiness claim.
routes.description_zh: 免认证的有界存活探测；有意不构成 readiness 声明。

routes.description_en: Unauthenticated same-origin static Web UI under data_dir()/ui. Missing bundle returns 503 not_available (LOCAL_UI_BUNDLE_UNAVAILABLE) with CSP. A present Origin/Referer must be this daemon's loopback HTTP origin. Not a readiness, Gate, or Profile claim.
routes.description_zh: 在 data_dir()/ui 下免认证同源静态 Web UI。缺少 bundle 时返回 503 not_available（LOCAL_UI_BUNDLE_UNAVAILABLE）并带 CSP。若请求携带 Origin/Referer，必须是本 daemon 的 loopback HTTP origin。不构成 readiness、Gate 或 Profile 声明。

routes.description_en: Component status projection (system, database, secret, provider, daemon, pi); Provider facts and SecretStore resolution use one loaded config snapshot.
routes.description_zh: 组件状态投影（system、database、secret、provider、daemon、pi）；Provider 事实与 SecretStore 解析使用同一份已加载配置快照。

routes.description_en: Alias of the snapshot-consistent status projection.
routes.description_zh: 快照一致 status 投影的别名。

routes.description_en: Redacted snapshot-consistent diagnostic projection including six-resource, headless-vault, and operability sections.
routes.description_zh: 快照一致的脱敏诊断投影，含六资源、headless vault 与可运维性小节。

routes.description_en: Observation-only dsh runtime projection: process-local sessions, fencing epoch, optional bound pid liveness via `/proc/{pid}` existence (never cmdline/environ). States are INACTIVE, ACTIVE, or CRASHED. A dsh response is never Task completion.
routes.description_zh: 仅观测的 dsh runtime 投影：进程内会话、fencing epoch、可选绑定 pid 存活（仅 `/proc/{pid}` 是否存在，永不打开 cmdline/environ）。状态为 INACTIVE、ACTIVE 或 CRASHED。dsh 响应绝不完成 Task。

routes.description_en: Observation-only bind/heartbeat/clear of a dsh process id, or op=apply to publish the Cos dsh binding as Path B selected-model and reload native Models from that bound account catalog. Not an authority writer. Invalid schema/op/pid and INACTIVE apply fail closed.
routes.description_zh: 仅观测地 bind/heartbeat/clear 一个 dsh 进程 pid，或 op=apply 把 Cos dsh binding 发布为 Path B selected-model，并按该绑定账户目录重载原生 Models。不是 authority writer。非法 schema/op/pid 以及 INACTIVE apply 失败闭合。

routes.description_en: Daemon-owned Provider proxy for the Pi agent path (`agent://personal/pi`). When a control-plane binding exists, the request model must match that binding and there is no fallback. Unbound agents still use `provider.json` / `selected-model.json`. Secrets resolve server-side only. Unary `stream:false` success responses carry `X-CognitiveOS-Provider-Network-Nanos`. Public `stream:true` is forwarded as SSE (`text/event-stream`) and flushes upstream bytes without waiting for a unary JSON body; streaming success omits the network-nanos header because it is unknown when headers flush. Pi conversations and private-candidate remain unary. When `COGNITIVEOS_PI_ROUTE_OBSERVATION=enabled` and the request carries one well-formed opaque `campaign-<32 lowercase hex>` correlation id, the daemon also echoes that id and reports `X-CognitiveOS-Daemon-Preflight-Nanos` (config/selected-model/SecretStore work, disjoint from the network exchange). Malformed or duplicate correlation headers are ignored; the product body is unchanged and nothing is persisted.
routes.description_zh: daemon 持有的 Pi 路径 Provider 代理（`agent://personal/pi`）。存在控制面 binding 时，请求 model 必须匹配该 binding，且无回退。未绑定 agent 仍使用 `provider.json` / `selected-model.json`。secret 仅在服务端解析。一元 `stream:false` 成功响应携带 `X-CognitiveOS-Provider-Network-Nanos`。公开 `stream:true` 按 SSE（`text/event-stream`）转发，并在不等待一元 JSON body 的情况下刷新上游字节；流式成功省略 network-nanos 头，因为刷新响应头时总时长未知。Pi 对话与 private-candidate 保持一元。当 `COGNITIVEOS_PI_ROUTE_OBSERVATION=enabled` 且请求携带一条形态正确的不透明 `campaign-<32 位小写 hex>` correlation id 时，daemon 还会回显该 id 并报告 `X-CognitiveOS-Daemon-Preflight-Nanos`（配置/selected-model/SecretStore，与网络交换互不重叠）。畸形或重复的 correlation 头被忽略；产品 body 不变，且绝不持久化。

routes.description_en: Non-secret selected-model projection for the Pi agent path. A control-plane binding, when present, is the selected model (`selected_snapshot_digest: binding`).
routes.description_zh: Pi 路径的非 secret selected-model 投影。存在控制面 binding 时，该 binding 的 model 即为 selected model（`selected_snapshot_digest: binding`）。

routes.description_en: Daemon-owned Provider proxy for the DeepSeek harness path (`agent://personal/dsh`). Independent of the Pi route: a dsh binding cannot be satisfied by posting to `/provider/v1/chat/completions`. Binding mismatch fails closed with no fallback. Unbound dsh still uses `provider.json` / `selected-model.json`.
routes.description_zh: daemon 持有的 DeepSeek harness 路径 Provider 代理（`agent://personal/dsh`）。与 Pi 路由独立：向 `/provider/v1/chat/completions` POST 不能满足 dsh binding。binding 不符失败闭合且无回退。未绑定 dsh 仍使用 `provider.json` / `selected-model.json`。

routes.description_en: Non-secret selected-model projection for the DeepSeek harness path. Independent of the Pi selected-model route.
routes.description_zh: DeepSeek harness 路径的非 secret selected-model 投影。与 Pi selected-model 路由独立。

routes.description_en: List named Provider Control Plane accounts (opaque secret_ref only; never API key material).
routes.description_zh: 列出命名 Provider Control Plane 账户（仅不透明 secret_ref；绝无 API key 材料）。

routes.description_en: Create a named OpenAI official, Anthropic official, or OpenAI-compatible account. Custom HTTP/private endpoints require durable grants. Optional api_key is consumed once into Secret Store and never returned. Discovery on create is foreground-only.
routes.description_zh: 创建命名的 OpenAI 官方、Anthropic 官方或 OpenAI 兼容账户。自定义 HTTP/私网端点需要持久授权。可选 api_key 只消费一次进入 Secret Store 且永不返回。创建时的发现仅前台执行。

routes.description_en: Inspect one Provider account by id (redacted; no key material).
routes.description_zh: 按 id 检视一个 Provider 账户（脱敏；无 key 材料）。

routes.description_en: Update endpoint trust. Authority, DNS-scope expansion, or HTTPS→HTTP requires reconfirm.
routes.description_zh: 更新端点信任。权威、DNS 范围扩大或 HTTPS→HTTP 需要 reconfirm。

routes.description_en: Delete an account. Active agent bindings fail closed (409).
routes.description_zh: 删除账户。存在活动 agent binding 时失败闭合（409）。

routes.description_en: Set, rotate, or remove the Secret Store key for one account. Material is never persisted in SQLite.
routes.description_zh: 为一个账户设置、轮换或移除 Secret Store 密钥。材料永不写入 SQLite。

routes.description_en: List discovered and manually configured models for one account.
routes.description_zh: 列出一个账户的已发现与手动配置模型。

routes.description_en: Foreground model discovery. Failure records an auditable error and must not wipe the catalog or bindings.
routes.description_zh: 前台模型发现。失败记录可审计错误，且不得清空目录或 binding。

routes.description_en: Manually add a model (`manually_configured`) with optional per-million prices.
routes.description_zh: 手动添加模型（`manually_configured`），可选百万 token 单价。

routes.description_en: Set a new price version for one model. Historical usage keeps its recorded pricing version.
routes.description_zh: 为一个模型设置新的价格版本。历史用量保留其记录的定价版本。

routes.description_en: List fixed agent account+provider+model bindings (pi and dsh only).
routes.description_zh: 列出固定的 agent 账户+provider+model binding（仅 pi 与 dsh）。

routes.description_en: Set one fixed binding. Optional expected_revision CAS; mismatch is HTTP 409 PROVIDER_BINDING_REVISION_STALE. No auto fallback, load balancing, or implicit model switch.
routes.description_zh: 设置一个固定 binding。可选 expected_revision CAS；不匹配时 HTTP 409 PROVIDER_BINDING_REVISION_STALE。无自动回退、负载均衡或隐式模型切换。

routes.description_en: Remove one agent binding.
routes.description_zh: 移除一个 agent binding。

routes.description_en: Query retained usage events. Unknown token/cost values are never coerced to zero.
routes.description_zh: 查询保留的用量事件。未知 token/成本值绝不会被当成 0。

routes.description_en: List observe-only token/amount budgets.
routes.description_zh: 列出仅观察的 token/金额预算。

routes.description_en: Set a monthly token/amount budget for an account or agent. Alerts do not block calls.
routes.description_zh: 为账户或 agent 设置月度 token/金额预算。告警不阻断调用。

routes.description_en: Remove one budget.
routes.description_zh: 移除一个预算。

routes.description_en: List 80%/100% budget alerts (deduped; observe-only).
routes.description_zh: 列出 80%/100% 预算告警（去重；仅观察）。

routes.description_en: Acknowledge one budget alert.
routes.description_zh: 确认一条预算告警。

routes.description_zh: 查询控制面审计事件（无密钥、prompt 或可逆载荷）。

routes.description_zh: 通用 disable 分发（Tool overlay disable，带 expected-version 守卫）。

routes.description_zh: 禁止：Resource Manager install 仅限 management 通道（即便在 management 也被拒绝）。

routes.description_en: Append a Context authorization fact set.
routes.description_zh: 追加 Context 授权事实集。

routes.description_en: Append a Context revocation fact (advances tenant revocation epoch).
routes.description_zh: 追加 Context 撤销事实（推进租户撤销 epoch）。

routes.description_en: Load one immutable Memory object by id.
routes.description_zh: 按 id 读取一个不可变 Memory 对象。

routes.description_en: Explain one Skill binding (package, revision, revocation state).
routes.description_zh: 解释一个 Skill binding（package、revision、撤销状态）。

routes.description_en: Explicit remember: creates a Memory candidate and runs deterministic admission.
routes.description_zh: 显式 remember：创建 Memory candidate 并执行确定性 admission。

routes.description_en: Forget an admitted Memory object via a durable tombstone.
routes.description_zh: 通过持久 tombstone 遗忘已接纳的 Memory 对象。

routes.description_en: Import an immutable local Skill package/revision.
routes.description_zh: 导入不可变的本地 Skill package/revision。

routes.description_en: Bind a compatible Skill revision to a scope target.
routes.description_zh: 将兼容的 Skill revision 绑定到目标 scope。

routes.description_en: Append an immutable Skill binding revocation.
routes.description_zh: 追加不可变的 Skill binding 撤销记录。

routes.description_en: Durably record raw user intent before any interpretation.
routes.description_zh: 在任何解释之前持久记录原始用户意图。

routes.description_en: Persist a probabilistic interpretation candidate; material ambiguity forces clarification_required.
routes.description_zh: 持久化概率性解释候选；实质歧义强制 clarification_required。

routes.description_en: Server-issued digest-bound contract preview; persists nothing.
routes.description_zh: 服务端签发的 digest 绑定合同预览；不持久化。

routes.description_en: Admit the exact preview digest and mint the TaskContract under epoch CAS.
routes.description_zh: 接纳精确 preview digest 并在 epoch CAS 下铸造 TaskContract。

routes.description_en: Candidate-only DeepSeek Harness adapter front door. Process-local sessions are activated explicitly; Workspace* candidates map onto existing public candidate admission. Daemon restart forgets sessions and fails closed. A dsh response never completes a Task.
routes.description_zh: 仅 candidate 的 DeepSeek Harness 适配器前门。会话必须显式激活且仅存在于进程内；Workspace* candidate 映射到既有 public candidate admission。daemon 重启后会话表为空并失败闭合。dsh 响应绝不完成 Task。

routes.description_en: Submit bounded public-Pi operation fields; the daemon recomputes parameter digests and performs candidate admission from the immutable Task policy.
routes.description_zh: 提交有界 public-Pi 操作字段；daemon 根据不可变 Task policy 重算参数 digest 并执行 candidate admission。

routes.description_en: Reconstruct bounded redacted lifecycle, Effect reconciliation, verification, acceptance, and durable cursor evidence for one task_ref from authority and Artifact CAS.
routes.description_zh: 从 authority 与 Artifact CAS 为一个 task_ref 重建有界脱敏的生命周期、Effect 对账、verification、acceptance 与持久游标证据。

routes.description_en: Return bounded Effect history for one task_ref: opaque original-key digest, stage, outcome/reconcile class, mutation count 0/1 or absent when indeterminate, and report refs. Receipts, raw parameters, and extra query fields are refused.
routes.description_zh: 返回一个 task_ref 的有界 Effect 历史：不透明 original-key digest、stage、outcome/reconcile class、mutation count 仅 0/1 或在不确定时缺省，以及 report refs。拒绝 receipt、原始参数和额外查询字段。

routes.description_en: Return bounded O2/O3/O4/O5/O13 observation for one task_ref. Empty collectors return observed_zero with a named negative control; prompt/body/receipt/capability query keys fail closed. O5 reuses redacted Effect history; O13 is durable audit cursor/replay with stale-cursor, digest-break, and gap negatives. Not a second authority API.
routes.description_zh: 返回一个 task_ref 的有界 O2/O3/O4/O5/O13 观测。空 collector 返回带具名 negative control 的 observed_zero；prompt/body/receipt/capability 查询键失败闭合。O5 复用脱敏 Effect 历史；O13 是持久审计游标回放，含过期游标、digest 断裂与缺口负例。不是第二套 authority API。

routes.description_en: Alias of GET /task/observation on the task resource prefix.
routes.description_zh: task 资源前缀上 GET /task/observation 的别名。

routes.description_en: Rejected: observation samples are daemon-authored; callers cannot write the plane.
routes.description_zh: 拒绝：观测样本由 daemon 写入；调用方不能写该平面。

routes.description_en: Forbidden: observation is a task-channel read plane, not a management authority API.
routes.description_zh: 禁止：观测是 task 通道只读平面，不是 management authority API。

routes.description_en: Forbidden: observation is a task-channel read plane, not a management authority API.
routes.description_zh: 禁止：观测是 task 通道只读平面，不是 management authority API。

routes.description_en: Read the default-off task-scoped authorized fault profile. Missing records mean faults stay off. Ordinary task callers are denied.
routes.description_zh: 读取默认关闭的 task 范围授权 fault profile。缺失记录表示故障注入保持关闭。普通 task 调用方被拒绝。

routes.description_en: Persist a default-off or campaign-authorized fixed fault profile for one task_ref. Unauthorized campaigns and task-channel callers fail closed. No raw parameter or receipt is stored.
routes.description_zh: 为一个 task_ref 持久化默认关闭或评测授权的固定 fault profile。未授权 campaign 与 task 通道调用方失败闭合。不存储原始参数或 receipt。

routes.description_en: Read the task/campaign-scoped pinned HTTPS origin allowlist. Missing records leave production HttpFetchReadOnly empty (fail closed). Ordinary task callers are denied.
routes.description_zh: 读取 task/campaign 范围的钉住 HTTPS origin 白名单。缺失记录表示生产 HttpFetchReadOnly 白名单保持为空（失败闭合）。普通 task 调用方被拒绝。

routes.description_en: Pin exact HTTPS origins (host or host:port) for one task_ref under an authorized campaign. GET/HEAD only; no credentials, redirects, inherited proxy, or request body. Unauthorized campaigns and task-channel callers fail closed.
routes.description_zh: 在授权 campaign 下为一个 task_ref 钉住精确 HTTPS origin（host 或 host:port）。仅 GET/HEAD；无凭据、不跟随重定向、不继承代理、无请求体。未授权 campaign 与 task 通道调用方失败闭合。

routes.description_en: Project registered native Tools with overlay lifecycle, execution_readiness, and whether each is currently Agent-exposed. Overlay state never enters the immutable descriptor digest.
routes.description_zh: 投影已登记原生 Tool 的 overlay lifecycle、execution_readiness，以及当前是否对 Agent 暴露。overlay 状态永不进入不可变 descriptor digest。

routes.description_en: Alias of the registered Tool lifecycle projection; stops the previous generic-authority fall-through on tool/discover.
routes.description_zh: 已登记 Tool lifecycle 投影的别名；阻止先前 tool/discover 落入通用 authority 处理器。

routes.description_en: Enable one registered operation_id. Quarantined and revoked Tools fail closed. Task-channel callers are denied.
routes.description_zh: 启用一个已登记 operation_id。被隔离或撤销的 Tool 失败闭合。task 通道调用方被拒绝。

routes.description_en: Disable one registered operation_id. Agent exposure updates atomically with the overlay.
routes.description_zh: 禁用一个已登记 operation_id。Agent 暴露随 overlay 原子更新。

routes.description_en: Quarantine one registered operation_id. Enable remains blocked until a later non-quarantine overlay is out of scope for this surface.
routes.description_zh: 隔离一个已登记 operation_id。在本表面内 enable 保持阻断。

routes.description_en: Revoke one registered operation_id. Revocation is terminal for this overlay.
routes.description_zh: 撤销一个已登记 operation_id。对本 overlay 而言撤销是终态。

routes.description_en: Read the current least Agent exposure set and digest for one task_ref.
routes.description_zh: 读取一个 task_ref 当前最窄 Agent 暴露集合及其 digest。

routes.description_en: Task-channel read of the same registered Tool lifecycle projection.
routes.description_zh: task 通道读取同一份已登记 Tool lifecycle 投影。

routes.description_en: Return the least Agent-exposed Tool set and exposure_digest for one task_ref. Extra prompt/body/receipt query keys fail closed.
routes.description_zh: 返回一个 task_ref 的最窄 Agent 暴露集合与 exposure_digest。额外的 prompt/body/receipt 查询键失败闭合。

routes.description_en: Record a bounded Tool selection receipt: candidate_set_digest must equal the current exposure digest, the selected operation_id must be exposed, and prompt/body/receipt restatement is refused.
routes.description_zh: 记录有界 Tool 选择收据：candidate_set_digest 必须等于当前暴露 digest，所选 operation_id 必须已被暴露，且拒绝 prompt/body/receipt 重述。

routes.description_en: Snapshot-first bounded Task watch with optional resume_from.
routes.description_zh: 快照优先的有界 Task watch，支持可选 resume_from。

routes.description_en: Task-bound Memory/Skill resource projection (requires task_ref); served through the `/task/resource/` prefix rewrite onto the shared resource handler.
routes.description_zh: Task 绑定的 Memory/Skill 资源投影（需要 task_ref）；经 `/task/resource/` 前缀重写复用共享 resource 处理器。

routes.description_en: Task-bound resource watch, served through the same prefix rewrite.
routes.description_zh: Task 绑定的资源 watch，经同一前缀重写提供。

routes.description_en: Return the latest daemon-authored redacted Memory/Skill consumption pins for one task_ref; query_text and skill_binding_id are rejected as restatement; forgotten, revoked, or digest-drifted records fail closed without pins.
routes.description_zh: 返回一个 task_ref 上最新的 daemon 写入脱敏 Memory/Skill 消费钉；query_text 与 skill_binding_id 视为重述并拒绝；遗忘、撤销或 digest 漂移的记录在返回钉之前失败闭合。

routes.description_en: Record a Task-trace Memory/Skill consumption bound to current authority facts.
routes.description_zh: 记录绑定当前权威事实的 Task trace Memory/Skill 消费。

routes.description_en: Write a secret-excluding Personal backup archive. Never copies authority SQLite, bootstrap secrets, bearer material, or provider-config.
routes.description_zh: 写入排除 secret 的 Personal 备份归档。永不复制 authority SQLite、bootstrap secret、bearer 或 provider-config。

routes.description_en: Verify one archive_id (schema, part digests, completeness, secret/SQLite exclusion) without mutating live layout.
routes.description_zh: 校验一个 archive_id（schema、分片 digest、完整性、secret/SQLite 排除）且不改写 live layout。

routes.description_en: Preflight then transactionally restore one archive_id. Failure rolls live trees back; secrets and SQLite stay uncopied.
routes.description_zh: 预检后事务恢复一个 archive_id。失败则回滚 live 树；secret 与 SQLite 仍不被复制。

routes.description_en: Forbidden: backup/restore are management-channel only.
routes.description_zh: 禁止：backup/restore 仅限 management 通道。

routes.description_en: Forbidden: backup/restore are management-channel only.
routes.description_zh: 禁止：backup/restore 仅限 management 通道。

routes.description_en: Forbidden alias of the management backup writer.
routes.description_zh: 禁止：management 备份写入器的 task 别名。

routes.description_en: Forbidden alias of the management restore writer.
routes.description_zh: 禁止：management 恢复写入器的 task 别名。

routes.description_en: Personal-private Project list from v26 `p11_project` rows. Empty list has no fake buttons. Cost is `unknown` and is never serialized as 0. Not Task-row impersonation and not P7-T05 inventory.
routes.description_zh: 从 v26 `p11_project` 行投影的 Personal-private Project 列表。空列表无假按钮。费用为 `unknown`，序列化里不出现 0。不是 Task 行冒充，也不动 P7-T05 inventory。

routes.description_en: Personal-private Project detail. A Task ref is not a Project id (404). Unconfirmed drafts have no Project row.
routes.description_zh: Personal-private Project 详情。Task ref 不是 Project id（404）。未确认草稿没有 Project 行。

routes.description_en: Current PlanRevision axis (stages, gap flags, confirm_status). Missing plan is empty/unavailable, not a fake wizard.
routes.description_zh: 当前 PlanRevision 流程轴（环、gap 标记、confirm_status）。无计划时为空/unavailable，不是假向导。

routes.description_en: Employee roster. Empty projection uses `authority_note: empty-roster`. Seated members list `employee_id`, state, responsible stages, model_bound, and current-manager flag. Not a third identity besides Employee.
routes.description_zh: 员工花名册。空投影使用 `authority_note: empty-roster`。已就位成员列出 `employee_id`、state、负责环、model_bound 与 current-manager 标记。不是 Employee 之外的第三套身份。

routes.description_en: Grant catalog for one Employee in one Project. Recipe mention is not a grant.
routes.description_zh: 一个 Project 内一名 Employee 的 Grant 目录。配方提及不是授权。

routes.description_en: Pending ApprovalPreview announcement list. Omits `preview_digest` (conversation/canvas announcement seam).
routes.description_zh: 待批 ApprovalPreview 宣布列表。省略 `preview_digest`（对话/画布宣布接缝）。

routes.description_en: Canvas preview-detail: includes `preview_digest` for management confirm. Not a chat Approve control.
routes.description_zh: 画布 preview-detail：含供 management 确认的 `preview_digest`。不是聊天 Approve 控件。

routes.description_en: Apply a candidate onto an open draft at exact `base_seq`. Wrong seq is conflict (N13).
routes.description_zh: 按精确 `base_seq` 把候选应用到未关闭草稿。错误 seq 为冲突（N13）。

routes.description_en: Mint a digest-bound ApprovalPreview (activation / plan-change / acceptance). Secret-shaped bytes are rejected at registration.
routes.description_zh: 签发 digest 绑定的 ApprovalPreview（activation / plan-change / acceptance）。secret 形态字节在登记时拒绝。

routes.description_en: Owner-management confirm of `{preview_id, preview_digest}`. G1 mints Project in `creating`; G2 writes AcceptanceFact then `active`. Stale digest is rejected.
routes.description_zh: Owner management 确认 `{preview_id, preview_digest}`。G1 铸造 `creating` 的 Project；G2 写入 AcceptanceFact 后进入 `active`。过期 digest 拒绝。

routes.description_en: Register one Employee per PlanRevision responsible_slot. Missing or extra slots are rejected. Not a Role=Agent merge.
routes.description_zh: 按 PlanRevision 每个 responsible_slot 登记一名 Employee。缺槽或多成员拒绝。不是 Role=Agent 合并。

routes.description_en: Begin sequential seating for one Employee. A second seating while another is seating is conflict.
routes.description_zh: 开始一名 Employee 的顺序就位。另一名仍在 seating 时冲突。

routes.description_en: Owner-management seating confirm. Missing model → pending; reject → refused; project-manager seating requires the unique current-manager slot.
routes.description_zh: Owner management 就位确认。无模型 → pending；拒绝 → refused；project-manager 就位占用唯一 current-manager 槽。

routes.description_en: Replace `runtime_binding_ref` without changing `employee_id`. Process death does not delete the Employee.
routes.description_zh: 替换 `runtime_binding_ref` 且不改 `employee_id`。进程退出不删除 Employee。

routes.description_en: Speech router plus T05 archive landing: whitelist-filtered delivered kinds persist under `cognitiveos.personal.conversation-archive/0.1`. Chatter stays audit-only. Legacy `conversation-projection/0.1` / `v01` is not coerced.
routes.description_zh: 发言路由加 T05 档案落地：白名单投递 kind 写入 `cognitiveos.personal.conversation-archive/0.1`。chatter 仅审计。旧 `conversation-projection/0.1` / `v01` 不被 coerce。

routes.description_en: Owner-management append of one archive record (`note`/`deliverable`/`handoff`/`blocked`/`decision-request`). Chatter and oversize bodies fail closed. Observation-only; not Task/Project completion. Legacy `conversation-projection/0.1` is not coerced.
routes.description_zh: Owner management 追加一条档案行（`note`/`deliverable`/`handoff`/`blocked`/`decision-request`）。chatter 与超长正文失败闭合。仅观察，不是 Task/Project 完成。旧 `conversation-projection/0.1` 不被 coerce。

routes.description_en: Bounded scoped index of Personal-private conversation archive refs. Requires `limit` 1..=32; omitted/oversize limit is unbounded resume. `include_bodies` is refused. Returns record_id/digest only. Does not reinterpret ADR-0058 `conversation-projection/0.1`.
routes.description_zh: 有界按 Project 索引 Personal-private 对话档案引用。必须带 `limit` 1..=32；缺省或超限视为无界 resume。`include_bodies` 拒绝。只返回 record_id/digest。不重解释 ADR-0058 `conversation-projection/0.1`。

routes.description_en: Single-record body fetch inside one Project. Not a bulk dump. Cross-scope record ids fail closed.
routes.description_zh: 在同一 Project 内读取单条档案正文。不是整库倾倒。跨范围 record_id 失败闭合。

routes.description_en: Record a handoff row with `authority_stays=1`. Chat cannot transfer authority.
routes.description_zh: 记录 `authority_stays=1` 的 handoff 行。聊天不能转移权威。

routes.description_en: Hidden Pi Personal Assistant (exact Pi 0.81.1 / `cognitiveos.private-candidate/1`): explain/navigate/research/propose registers a digest-bound draft candidate with typed provenance (`sources` | `owner-stated` | `assistant-assumption`) and, for research/propose, a daemon preview announcement. Candidate-only: no Approve, no archive/SecretStore/Memory/authority write, default-deny tools except research `HttpFetchReadOnly`. Pi is not an Installed Agent. Closed schema rejects grant/secret/trigger-arm fields.
routes.description_zh: 隐藏 Pi Personal Assistant（exact Pi 0.81.1 / `cognitiveos.private-candidate/1`）：explain/navigate/research/propose 把带 digest 的草稿候选登记进 daemon，并强制 typed 出处（`sources` | `owner-stated` | `assistant-assumption`）；research/propose 另发 daemon preview 宣布。只产 candidate：无 Approve、无 archive/SecretStore/Memory/权威写；除 research 的 `HttpFetchReadOnly` 外 default-deny。Pi 不是 Installed Agent。封闭 schema 拒绝 grant/secret/trigger-arm 字段。

routes.description_zh: 禁止：Project 聚合仅限 management 通道。

routes.description_zh: 禁止：对话单条读取仅限 management 通道。

routes.description_en: One-shot private Unix-socket completion used by the daemon-launched Pi candidate process; Authorization headers are forbidden.
routes.description_zh: daemon 启动的 Pi candidate 进程使用的一次性私有 Unix socket completion；禁止 Authorization 头。
